actions.action: Lift nursery pot out and pour off standing water
Slide plant out and inspect roots/rhizomes
Cut off rotten rhizomes/roots with clean blade and let cuts dry a day
Repot into 60/40 universal soil and perlite/pumice/bark mix
If crowded, move up to a pot 2-5 cm larger
Check soil dryness with a chopstick before watering
Water only when soil is fully dry
Empty decorative pot 15 minutes after watering
Cut the yellowing stem at the base once mostly yellow

reason: The answer names overwatering/root rot as the main cause and advises checking the roots, repotting in a chunkier mix and watering far less often, which matches the fix that worked; pruning only mostly-yellow stems is not harmful.
